one_line: Gupta emperor whose western campaigns ended the Western Kshatrapas and brought Malwa–Gujarat into his empire.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered, the composed bearing of a seasoned ruler and commander
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, medium-brown north Indian complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a small tilak on the forehead, default expression calm and assessing with a faint confident half-smile
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a high, medium-length topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothed back; he wears a simple gold circlet-band close to the skull with a small central round gem above the brow
appearance.costume: a knee-length, long-sleeved Gupta-style angarkha tunic in deep maroon-red fine cotton, crossing right over left and tied with an inner tie, worn over slim off-white cotton churidar trousers; over this, a mustard-gold silk uttariya (shawl) with a thin maroon border draped from the left shoulder across the chest and looping around the right forearm; at the waist a broad dark-brown leather belt with a simple rectangular brass buckle; feet in soft mid-calf brown leather boots with turned-down cuffs; jewellery limited to a pair of medium-sized gold kundala earrings, a single plain gold torque-style neck band, and two slim gold bangles on his sword hand wrist, all refined but not ostentatious
appearance.signature: a straight-edged iron sword with a slightly flared tip and simple crossguard, housed in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, worn suspended from his belt on the left hip and usually held resting lightly with one hand on the hilt

ref_desc: Chandragupta II Vikramaditya has an oval, medium-brown face with a neat short beard, black hair in a high topknot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon angarkha, off-white churidar, mustard-gold uttariya, brown boots and belt, and carrying a plain-hilted straight iron sword in a dark-brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chandragupta II Vikramaditya: an early-40s, athletic Indian emperor with an oval medium-brown face, high cheekbones, straight nose, and a neat short beard and moustache, a small tilak on his forehead and a calm, confident expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a high topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothed back, with a simple gold circlet-band fitting close to his skull and a small round gem centered above the brow. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved Gupta-style angarkha tunic in deep maroon-red fine cotton, crossing right over left and tied, over slim off-white churidar trousers. A mustard-gold silk uttariya with a thin maroon border is draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around his right forearm. At his waist is a broad dark-brown leather belt with a brass buckle, and he has soft mid-calf brown leather boots with turned-down cuffs. Add restrained jewellery: medium gold kundala earrings, a plain gold torque neck band and two slim gold bangles on his sword wrist. His signature weapon is a straight-edged iron sword with a slightly flared tip and simple crossguard, in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings on his left hip, one hand resting lightly on the hilt; keep the colour palette to deep maroon red, mustard gold, off-white, dark brown and matte gold, and present him clearly from head to toe for consistent redraws.
